name: Equinix

profile.capacity_note: not published per-building; Equinix's own page provides no capacity or investment figures
profile.research_note:
Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 40 (Equinix missing-address campaign): identified this unnamed row as Equinix LA7 via six agreeing aggregator sources, resolving a prior sessions unmatched building code, research_status remains complete.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Equinix operates a very large global portfolio and this session found its own per-building pages under equinix.com/data-centers/ to be inconsistently populated: some individual IBX codes 404 entirely (confirmed fresh this session for DC17), and others that do load, such as DC7, checked fresh this session, still omit street address and square footage, deferring that detail to a downloadable specification sheet not reachable by this research pass. Given this, addresses in this batch rely on aggregator sourcing, preferring cases with independent multi source agreement, per this registrys standard source hierarchy. This specific row is an unnamed Equinix building in Torrance, CA per registry data. A prior research pass checked the operators own LA1 building page and confirmed LA1 is a different facility, in downtown Los Angeles, not Torrance, leaving this row unmatched to any Equinix metro code. This session identifies the match: multiple aggregators, DataCenterMap, PeeringDB, Connectbase, Inflect, OCOLO, and datacenters.com, independently and consistently identify Equinix LA7 as the Torrance facility, at 1501 Francisco Street, Torrance, CA, six agreeing sources. An UPSTACK marketplace listing for the same facility includes frmr-vz in its own URL slug, consistent with LA7, like several other Equinix buildings in this registry, likely having originated in Equinix 2017 acquisition of Verizons data center business.
sources_tried: A prior sessions confirmation that Equinix LA1 is a different, downtown Los Angeles facility, and this sessions DataCenterMap, PeeringDB, Inflect, OCOLO, datacenters.com, and UPSTACK listings all specific to Equinix LA7 and agreeing this is the Torrance facility
profile.regional_context: Per Equinix's own site, the Silicon Valley metro comprises 12 facilities (SV1-SV5, SV8, SV10-SV12x, SV14-SV16) described as the region's largest retail colocation footprint, serving over 10,500 customers including 4,900+ enterprises and 2,000+ network service providers.
profile.facility_type_note: Part of Equinix's Silicon Valley campus, spanning Santa Clara, San Jose (including the Great Oaks campus), Palo Alto, Sunnyvale, with a separate facility in Torrance in the Los Angeles area also grouped in this state.

capacity_absent_because: the operator's site refuses automated requests, so its published figures cannot be read here
